files.title: Same resource, same day, many rows
files.expected: One row per student, resource and day: the file documents sum_click as that day's count.
files.found: 2,195,960 of 10,655,280 rows (20.6%) repeat a student-resource-day already seen; 787,170 are exact copies. 85% of registrations have some.
files.decided: Summed, treating repeats as separate sessions. A sensitivity run drops exact copies instead and reports whether any result moves.

files.title: Due dates nobody meets
files.expected: A listed due date is a deadline: most work arrives by it.
files.found: For BBB CMAs, CCC CMAs and DDD CMAs, no submissions arrive by the listed date, against 76%–94% for every other module and type. Found while testing RQ1, where it made one module look like nobody submits on time.
files.decided: Those dates are treated as having no deadline, so on-time and late are not measured for them. Decided from the non-test terms only.

files.title: A module the model never meets
files.expected: Every module runs in every term, so training covers what testing sees.
files.found: Module CCC ran only in 2014, so it appears in validation and test but never in training (4,434 registrations). In EEE, GGG nothing is due before day 28.
files.decided: Split kept as planned: changing it after seeing this would be tuning. CCC is reported on its own as a module the model never trained on.

files.title: One band without a % sign
files.expected: All ten deprivation bands are written the same way.
files.found: Every '10-20%' row (3,516) is written '10-20', so it sorts out of order.
files.decided: Relabelled before any grouping or chart.

files.title: Gone before day one
files.found: 2,678 students (8.2%) unregistered before the module started: 26% of all withdrawals.
files.decided: Removed from every analysis. They never began, so counting them would make withdrawal look more predictable than it is.

files.title: Active after leaving
files.expected: No activity once a student has unregistered.
files.found: 1,279 registrations show 98,745 clicks after their unregistration date, and 415 submitted work after it.
files.decided: Activity after the unregistration day is dropped, so it cannot leak the outcome.

files.title: Deprivation band missing
files.expected: Missing at random, a few percent everywhere.
files.found: 1,111 missing (3.4%), concentrated by region: North Region 40%, Ireland 22%, every other region under 2%. More often missing for Distinction (6.6%) than Withdrawn (2.3%).
files.decided: Kept as its own 'Unknown' group in the fairness audit. Dropping these rows would drop most students from two regions.

files.title: Grades from last time
files.expected: Each submission belongs to this attempt.
files.found: 1,909 submissions, across 526 registrations, are results carried over (banked) from an earlier attempt.
files.decided: Excluded from the on-time submission features. They say nothing about this attempt.

files.title: Withdrawn, but no date
files.expected: Every withdrawn student has an unregistration date, and only withdrawn students have one.
files.found: 93 withdrawals have no date (87 of them in the test term), and 9 students with a date are recorded as Fail.
files.decided: The final result defines the outcome. Undated withdrawals count as still enrolled at day 28, and a sensitivity run drops them.

files.title: No registration date
files.decided: Registration timing is filled with the module's median, plus a flag saying it was missing.

files.title: Empty week fields
files.expected: Resources say which week they were planned for.
files.found: 82% of resources have no planned week.
files.decided: Not used. Weeks are computed from click dates instead.

files.title: The same student twice
files.found: 7,346 registrations belong to 3,538 students with more than one; 972 students are in both training and test terms.
files.decided: Kept, as planned: a live early-warning system sees returning students too. Uncertainty is bootstrapped by student.

files.title: Never opened the course
files.expected: Students who register use the online classroom at least once.
files.found: 3,365 registrations have no clicks at all; 89% of them withdrew. 1,152 remain after removing those gone before day one.
files.decided: Kept. Zero clicks is a real, strong signal, recorded as 0, not as missing.

files.title: Blank scores, undated exams
files.expected: Every submission has a score and every assessment a due date.
files.found: 173 submissions have no score; 11 assessments have no due date, all exams.
files.decided: No change needed. Scores are not model inputs, and final exams fall long after day 28.

files.title: Duplicates and orphans
files.expected: One row per student per module per term, and every click and submission links back to a registration.
files.found: No duplicate registrations and no orphan rows in any table.
